page.layout: One text column, full width. Page number 3 at the top right. Heading block at the top: dedication title (two lines of title and name, then the addressee lines). Below it, a centred address line to the Orders. Then the body text begins with a large woodcut initial S. Bottom right: catchword "&" with signature "A 2" at the foot.

main_text.head: Illustri & generoso Domino, D. GVILHELMO LVDOVICO, Comiti in Nassou Catzenellenbogen, Vianden, Dietz, Domino in Beilstein, Gubernatori Frisiae inter Flevum & Lavicam, itemque civitatis Groning. & agri circumvicini, ac Drentiae, domino suo clementissimo.
Nobilissimis, amplissimisq; ORDINIBUS provinciae, quae civitate Groninga, & agro Frisico circumjecto continetur, dominis & Mecoenatibus suis plurimum colendis.
main_text.p: SEPTENNIVM nunc est, inclyte & generosissime Comes, Domine clementissime, nobilissimi amplissimiq; Ordines, cum huc venit Franciscus Petitaeus Bethuniensis, historiam meditans confoederatarum regionum in hac Germania inferiore, & materiam conquirens, meq; tum precibus suis, tum aliorum intercessione perpulit, ut summatim de statu rerum provinciae huius aliquid conjicerem in chartā, quod cederet in usum historiae ipsius. Sed erat id, quod tum effluxit mihi festinanti,

page.notes: The woodcut initial S is decorated; the first word is read as SEPTENNIVM from the visible letters EPTENNIVM after it. Italic setting of the body paragraph is read from the slanted type and may be partly roman. "Nassou" is read from the overprinted "Naffou" and may be Nassau. The page ends mid-sentence, continuing on the next page.
